tools.name: find_clothes
tools.description: Find clothes that match a description. For when the user describes a piece of clothing they want ("black pleated wide-leg trousers", "cream cable-knit jumper like the one I saved"). Natural requests are fine ("a navy midi wrap dress for a summer wedding under £60 in a size 12"): the occasion is kept

tools.name: find_clothes_by_image
tools.description: Find clothes that look like a picture. For when the user shares or points at a picture of an outfit or item (a Pinterest pin, a saved post, a photo). Takes the image's direct https link. Returns visually similar eBay listings from the Clothing, Shoes and Accessories category only, in eBay's look-ali
